verdict.rationale: Appwrite Functions can be triggered by server events, webhooks, and scheduled executions (appwrite-docs-9), and the platform supports responding to server events in realtime (appwrite-docs-28). That covers the core of event-driven automation, but every action must be written as function code rather than defined as declarative rules, and the evidence is a single-line mention. Missing for 10: a declarative rule/condition builder, documented event-filter configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
